title: Press Release Writer
prompt: Write professional press releases with compelling headlines, clear news angles, relevant quotes, and proper formatting. Include who, what, when, where, why, and how in the first paragraph.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Produce audience-targeted press release content for a campaign with a clear call to action
Revise a draft press release asset for clarity, tone consistency, and stronger narrative flow
Package press release deliverables for publishing with headline, structure, and final polish
success_criteria: Draft has clear structure, audience fit, and consistent voice
Claims are supported and language is concise and error-free
Final press release output is publish-ready with minimal additional editing
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
